Команда фонду спільно з партнерами перед:
The foundation's team, together with partners, handed over generators, power banks and lighting kits to the frontline communities of the Pologiv district. Assistance is aimed primarily at families with children, the elderly, and residents with reduced mobility.

Due to constant shelling of the energy infrastructure, people remain without light and heat for a long time. The donated kits make it possible to store medicine, charge communication devices and light up homes in the dark.

The work continues: the foundation continues to collect and distribute the necessary equipment together with international partners.

Чому «Фонд розвитку міжнародної співпрац: Why the International Cooperation Development Fund?
Бо ми об'єднуємо небайдужих людей з усьо: Because we unite caring people from all over the world around the needs of Ukrainian communities. International cooperation helps to respond more quickly to humanitarian challenges and support those most in need.
Благодійну організацію «Фонд розвитку мі: The charity organization "Fund for the Development of International Cooperation" was created on the initiative of Denis Valeryovych Krylov and Oleksandr Mykolayovych Lozychenko. These are experienced and caring people who directed their abilities to the realization of the foundation's mission. The purpose of the activity is to support the residents of the Zaporizhzhia region, primarily internally displaced persons from the blocked territories of the Pologiv region and the population of the front-line zones.
Пологівський район із населенням 172 500: Pologiv district with a population of 172,500 people has been partially blocked by the armed forces of the Russian Federation since the beginning of March 2022. Part of the territories is in the front-line zone and under massive shelling of civilian infrastructure. People were forced to leave their homes or were left without access to their usual living conditions. Our foundation joined the movement of caring Ukrainians and the world community to help compatriots with the most necessary things: food, hygiene products, water, legal support and other assistance.
Організація проявляє повагу до честі та: The organization shows respect for the honor and dignity of a person, for the human personality. The goal of humanitarian activity: to protect human life and health and ensure his right to respect.
Організація не робить будь-якого розрізн: The organization does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, class or political opinion. We are only trying to alleviate the suffering of people and first of all those who need it the most.
Організація не може приймати будь-яку ст: The organization cannot take any side in armed conflicts and enter into disputes of a political, racial, religious or ideological nature.
Цілі організації є незалежними від політ: The goals of the organization are independent of the political, economic, military or other goals of individuals and organizations associated with the territory where humanitarian activities are carried out.
